name: Interest
overview: Scripture clearly instructs believers not to charge interest, or usury, to fellow Israelites, especially those who are poor or in need, emphasizing compassion and brotherly love (Exodus 22:25; Leviticus 25:36-37; Deuteronomy 23:19). While lending with interest to strangers is permitted (Deuteronomy 23:20), the people of God are called to a higher standard of generosity and trust in God's provision. The concern for fair and loving treatment within the community is underscored by the complaints of the people in Nehemiah 5:1, highlighting the importance of avoiding exploitation among brethren.
